## Observation

`make verify` (integration tier) fails on a host that has a `git-remote-s3` binary on PATH from a separate install, when the worktree venv was provisioned by `make install` / `make worktree`:

```
tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py::test_git_remote_s3_api_surface_contract
E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'git_remote_s3'
```

Measured 2026-11-02 PST in a fresh `make worktree` checkout at `66bfebcf7f2` (plus an unrelated sync change): `which -a git-remote-s3` → `~/.local/bin/git-remote-s3`; the worktree `.venv/bin/python -c "import git_remote_s3"` → ModuleNotFoundError. 20,360 default-tier tests passed; this was the only failure in the 206-test integration tier.

## Cause (from the source)

The test's `skipif` checks `shutil.which("git-remote-s3")` (a binary anywhere on PATH), but the body imports the Python package from the running interpreter. `make install` syncs `--extra dev --extra metrics` plus `TEST_EXTRAS := reviewbot ui grounding-terraform`, which does not include `s3`. So the guard and the body test different things: any host with the helper installed outside the venv runs the test without the package and fails.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The skip condition checks the thing the test uses (the `git_remote_s3` package importable in the running interpreter, e.g. `pytest.importorskip`), or the test-extras set includes `s3` and the CI parity test is updated to match; the choice is recorded here.
- [x] `make verify` passes this test (or skips it) on a host with `git-remote-s3` on PATH and no `[s3]` extra in the venv.

## Resolution (2026-11-02 PST)

- **AC1, both options taken.** Gerrit 3250 (`346a76f1c87`) added `s3` to `TEST_EXTRAS` and to the gating cell's `uv sync`, and declared `s3` an intentional sweep-interpreters divergence. Gerrit 3251 (`e642101fb56`) changed the guard to `pytest.importorskip("git_remote_s3")`. Two changes were needed because the Verified lane runs main's workflow against the patchset tree.
- **AC2.** On this host, with `~/.local/bin/git-remote-s3` on PATH and no `[s3]` in the venv, the new guard reports `1 skipped`. After `make install`, which now installs git-remote-s3 0.3.2, `tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py` reports 24 passed. The full integration tier reports 203 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed, where it had 1 failure before. CI run 41585998116 installed `--extra s3` in all 4 cells and passed under `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1`, where a skip would have been an error.
